Closes #3115

`BOT_SEED_RATINGS` is now computed in `const` from `SKILL_ELO_TABLE`, and `jackioh-server bot-calibrate --write` rewrites the calibration's items in `crates/server/src/config.rs` in place. I did not run a real `bot-calibrate --write`, which plays about an hour of games. I covered the writer with tests on the real `config.rs` text and a temp copy. I also ran the built binary from `/tmp`: it stopped at once with "--write cannot read crates/server/src/config.rs … (run from the repository root)". `--write=1` is rejected as an unrecognized option.

## What changed

- **`config.rs`:**
  - `BOT_SEED_RATINGS` is `[f64; SKILL_ELO_TABLE.len()]`, filled by `seed_ratings_from_curve()`. `BOT_STRENGTHS` still reads `BOT_SEED_RATINGS[i]` in `const`, so no seed number is stated twice.
  - The doc comments of the three items say `--write` where they said "paste".
- **`cli/bot_calibrate.rs`:**
  - `--write` is a bare flag.
  - `CONFIG_RS` names the file, `config_items` spells the three items (`BOT_CALIBRATION_GENERATION`, `SKILL_ELO_ANCHOR`, `SKILL_ELO_TABLE`), and `rewrite_config` and `write_config` do the rewriting.
  - The printed report now ends with those three items, never a `BOT_SEED_RATINGS` row, which would have broken the `const`.
  - With `--write`, `run` checks that `config.rs` can be rewritten before the games start, writes after printing the report, and says on stderr whether the file changed.
- **`main.rs`, `crates/server/README.md`, `docs/bot-calibration.md`, `spec/rulings/R748000.md`, `training/README.md`:** wording only. The Results sections of `docs/bot-calibration.md` and R2214000's history are untouched.
